shellCommands.command: for f in pages/404.js pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/index.js pages/blog/[id].js pages/blog/index.js pages/api/posts/[id].js pages/api/posts/index.js components/AppProvider.js next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; echo; done
curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 http://localhost:3000/ && echo "still up" || echo "server stopped"
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 http://localhost:3000/ && echo "still up" || echo "server stopped"; true
sleep 1; curl -s -o /dev/null -m 2 http://localhost:3000/ && echo "still up" || echo "server stopped"
